rows.label: Sfx: Heartwood's cast and root arms, before the shared rune-crack fallback
rows.why: Rootfast's two voices (v85 section 4), in the synth only. The arms are added BEFORE the shared rune-crack fallback, and the fallback line is re-emitted unchanged (last), so the 11 other relics that still fall through keep it and any other relic's arms row on the same anchor composes in either order. Through the patched play() both arms reproduce their lab candidates (worst 6e-08; the root on two noise draws), 76 other voices are unchanged (worst 2e-07), and ult/heartwood is no longer rune-crack. Rune-crack fallback on this base: 12 relics fall through to it today, including heartwood and bindweed. ult/bindweed-root also falls through to rune-crack here (6e-8), so Tendril's root voice does not exist on this base.

Reference levels:
- hit@11 (Heartwood's blow): loudest 50 ms 0.1141-0.1199 over 12 draws.
- Wall tick: 0.0105-0.0118.
- Tendril's root: 0.1035-0.1119, which is -0.8 dB re the blow.

CAST, pick 5 RISING of 6:
- A sine climbing a fourth, 300 -> 400 Hz, over the first 0.3 s, then held. Pulsed 28 -> 40 a second; g 0.2768; 13 synth calls.
- RATE 33/s, PULSED 0.65. NOTE 356 Hz, under 420. SHIFT +130 c. ALONE +0.3 dB. Audible 390 ms.
- TOP -2.9 dB re hit@11 and +16.8 dB re the wall.
- Worst register 0.75, against the dry creak.
- Tiebreak: KNOT 0.73, TIMBER 0.74 and SAP 0.73 tie to 0.05. KNOT and TIMBER lose on calls (14 and 28); SAP ties on 13 calls and loses on list order. DEEP (a 90 Hz groan) loses the register at 0.78 against the death voice. GROAN is out (0.84 against the blow).
- Controls, each failing the gate it controls: HELD rate 240/s; WITHER SHIFT -669 c; DRY note 534 Hz and SHIFT -733 c; CRACK ALONE +29.4 dB; RUNECRACK fails several gates.

ROOT, pick 3 G-7dB of a 5-rung ladder:
- Tendril's DEEP body verbatim, with only g changed, 0.5179 -> 0.2313.
- TOP 0.0698: -4.1 dB re Tendril's root (the compressor turns a 7 dB gain step into 4.1 dB), -4.3 dB re hit@11, +14.8 dB re the wall.
- REG 0.99 and ENV-CORR 0.99 against Tendril's root. The crack lands at 206 ms and stands +46.4 dB.
- On the blow's frame, with the blows the wire run heard (0, 16, 32 and a crit of 66):
  - the root keeps +6.9 dB in its 50 Hz band;
  - the blow keeps +22.9 dB in its own band;

- Controls each fail as they should: FULL (not quieter), FAINT (not heard), PARADOX-PIN (REG 0.65 and ENV-CORR 0.29), BACK (ENV-CORR 0.86).

DECLARED READINGS (all written in the lab docstring) and FLAGS FOR RICK
(1) Tendril's root voice is not on this base.
- 'bindweed-root' is on sc-tendril-fx and later tips; on b11 it plays rune-crack.
- So I made 'heartwood-root' as Tendril's arm body, read from 02-chain/sc-tendril-fx.html and checked line for line against bindweed_voice_lab's DEEP, with only g changed.
- It has its own id so it applies on this base and on a tip that also carries 'bindweed-root'. The carry check onto sc-ironhail-fxout proves that.
(2) "A root" means every rooted blow (T.rooted), re-roots included.
- That is 2318 voices, against 1282 new holds.
- Reason: this matches the design's "every blow roots" and the lab's own "roots a cast". The other choice would be to voice new holds only.
(3) "Quieter at 1.0s than at the vine's longer holds" (the vine holds 0.3 x stacks, 1.2 s at the cap).
- The reading: at least 3 dB under Tendril's quietest draw. The 3 dB is this lab's number, not the design's. The literal hold ratio, -1.6 dB, is printed but not taken.
- Pick rule: the loudest rung that passes. That is G-7dB, which measures -4.1 dB after the compressor.
(4) "Green creak" was cut twice, both recorded in the docstring.
- First cut: green meant an octave under the dry creak. Of 33 constructions tried under that octave, 32 landed in the register of the verdant casts or the blow (Thornwake 0.82-0.90).
- The one survivor was DEEP, a 90 Hz groan, which clears every register but only by 0.02 (0.78 against the death voice).
- Second cut: green means the note sits under the lowest note the dry creak reaches (420 Hz). DEEP still competes under it; RISING wins the pre-written register tiebreak.
- If Rick prefers the stricter octave reading, heartwood-cast-2-deep.wav is his overrule clip.
(5) Two instruments were corrected before the picks.
- The inherited crack test (crack_info STAND/JUMP) read every click train as a crack. Replaced by ALONE, which compares the loudest high-passed millisecond with the loudest other one 20 ms or more away.
- The centroid fall (FALL-C) read steady creaks as falling. Replaced by SHIFT, a spectral cross-correlation between the first and last 100 ms.
- The frame blows for the root now come from the wire run (0-32 dmg, crits to 66), not the blade's 11.
(6) Information only, outside the house rule's scope (the rule checks the school's and type's casts). Against every ult voice on the ironhail tip (101):
- RISING crosses 0.80 with 5 other relics' voices: Lastlight's cold 0.88, Cindercleave's jet 0.86, Foregone's reverse 0.81, Gravemourn's hand 0.80, Ironhail's cast 0.80.
- For comparison: KNOT and SAP cross with 3 voices, DEEP with 13 (Threshmaw's cast 0.94).
- The reused root inherits Tendril's 0.81-0.83 against Twinshade, Shroudmaul, Grudgebearer and Cindercleave.
(7) In the real window, 5 of the 13 roots sit under +3 dB where the fight is loud. The median is +10.9 dB.
